companyDescription: AI-driven drug discovery (TechBio) · REC-4881 in FDA registrational-pathway discussions for familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) · partnered with Sanofi/Roche ($500M+ milestones delivered) · Q2 2026 earnings due Aug 5, 2026
priceNote: Near the bottom of its 52-week range ($2.77-$7.18) and below its 200-day moving average heading into Q2 2026 earnings (tomorrow, Aug 5, before market open). Stock fell 16.89% in the past month on a mid-July trial-data scare + insider Form 144 filing, but Morgan Stanley just raised its target to $5.50 (from $5.00) and ARK Invest bought 260,000 shares — real disagreement between bears and bulls right into the print.
summary: Recursion reports Q2 2026 results tomorrow (Aug 5, before the open) — a binary near-term event for a stock that swung +7.6% to +13.3% on its last earnings beat (May 6) and -7.9% on a mid-July trial-data scare plus an insider Form 144 filing. The core thesis is unchanged: REC-4881 has FDA engagement underway on a registrational pathway for FAP (update expected 2H26), the Sanofi/Roche partnered pipeline has delivered $500M+ in milestones, and cash runway is guided into early 2028. But short interest sits at ~35% and the stock trades near its 52-week low despite Morgan Stanley just lifting its target to $5.50 and ARK Invest adding 260,000 shares. Analyst consensus is $7.25 (+128% from here), with a wide $3-$11 range reflecting real disagreement, not noise.

catalysts.name: REC-4881 FDA Registrational Pathway Update
catalysts.description: Recursion has guided to an FDA update on the potential registrational study design/pathway for REC-4881 in FAP, following the positive TUPELO Phase 1b/2 data (75% of evaluable patients with reduced polyp burden, 43% median reduction at 12 weeks).

risks: Binary earnings event tomorrow (Aug 5) for a stock with a track record of double-digit single-day swings in both directions on its last two prints
Short interest near 35% and a former director's Form 144 filing (early July) signal real bearish positioning and a potential share-supply overhang
Mid-July 2026 saw an unspecified 'unfavorable trial data' headline drive a -7.9% day — the exact program/readout was not detailed in coverage, adding an unresolved overhang into earnings
Pre-profitability biotech burning ~$81M/quarter in free cash flow with -840% profit margins; P/S near 27x despite the depressed share price
Wide analyst target dispersion ($3-$11) shows genuine disagreement on valuation methodology, not just normal estimate noise
FAP is a rare disease with a small standalone commercial market — the read-through to Recursion's broader AI-discovery platform matters more than this indication's own economics

estimateDates.note: Cash runway confirmation + Sanofi/Roche milestone update is the swing factor
Registrational study design guidance for FAP

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed holds at 3.50-3.75% under Chair Warsh; next FOMC decision is Sep 15-16, 2026, with the committee split between a pause and a further 2026 hike.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core inflation remains sticky above target and the 10-year yield is elevated — a general headwind for pre-profitability biotech capital costs, though Recursion's Sanofi/Roche milestone cash flow reduces reliance on capital markets somewhat.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Clinical-stage biotech catalysts (earnings, FDA pathway updates) are largely macro-independent in direction — tomorrow's print and the FDA update will move the stock far more than any Fed signal between now and September.
macroRisk.summary: LOW — the near-term catalyst calendar (earnings tomorrow, FDA update in H2) is clinical/financial-results-driven rather than rate-sensitive, though the broader pre-profitability biotech sector still carries some risk-appetite sensitivity heading into the Sep 15-16 FOMC.
